purpose: determine whether Build 1649370 contains a dedicated server or can use the existing 2.6.9.7 server

build_1649370_client.community_source: E:\GAME\COD\1649370\src\codol_rebuild has no online/network/server module; README states that multiplayer and a complete match loop are not implemented
build_1649370_client.interpretation: The 1649370 image is client-only. It can consume a server's loadingnewmap notice, but it does not contain SV_SpawnServer/SV_Startup or the server-side game/bot code.

reference_2697_server.interpretation: This is a complete 2.6.9.7 server with bot support, but it is version-bound to the 2.6.9.7 protocol.

compatibility.assessment: The 1649370 client image does not contain the IW4OL/2.6.9.7 protocol markers, while codol_dedrun.exe rejects clients with a different protocol version. A direct pairing is therefore not supported by the artifacts; an adapter would require the 1649370 wire protocol, which is not present in the workspace.

conclusion: Build 1649370 has no local dedicated server in the workspace. The existing 2.6.9.7 codol_dedrun.exe is a complete server but speaks the 2.6.9.7 protocol, and the 1649370 client does not carry matching IW4OL markers. A playable local bot match therefore needs either a 1649370 server implementation or a protocol adapter derived from 1649370 wire captures; neither exists yet. This is the current G2 hard blocker.
